title: Resource pack
description: A resource pack's manifest (#1860): its id, its name, its own version, the game version it targets, and the resources it provides (textures, models, regions, region pieces and realms), each by its id. The game's own resources are the default pack; a player's pack (#1858) shares this format. One file per pack, named after its id.

id.description: Stable: lowercase words joined by underscores.

game_version.description: The game version the pack targets, major.minor.patch.

textures.description: Each texture's file by its id, relative to the pack's root (res:// for the default pack), never climbing out of it.

models.description: Each model's file (#1864), a .glb or .gltf, by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The images a model uses come with it.

regions.description: Each region drawn whole in one Markdown file (#1861), by its id (an instance blueprint's or a variant's region), relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it.

region_pieces.description: Each region arranged from region pieces (#1861), by its id: its pieces' Markdown files, relative to the pack's root, the start piece among them unless it's a variant that changes only some of its blueprint's pieces (#1590).

realms.description: Each realm's Markdown file (#1861), by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The game plays every realm a pack has.
